name: WakeMetric – Uptime Monitoring, SSL & Domain Expiry Monitor
author: wakemetrics

sections.description:
Keep your WordPress site online, secure, and monitored 24/7 with WakeMetric.

Every second your website is down costs sales, damages customer trust, and negatively impacts your Google SEO rankings. WakeMetric is an automated cloud monitoring solution built specifically for WordPress sites. It continuously checks your site’s availability every 15 minutes, tracks your SSL certificate health, and monitors your domain registration renewal date — displaying live metrics right inside your WordPress admin dashboard.

No complicated setup. No separate account registration. No credit card required. Connect with a single click and start monitoring in less than 60 seconds.

Why Choose WakeMetric Over Other Monitoring Tools?

  • Zero Performance Overhead on Your Server: Unlike self-hosted monitoring plugins that run heavy internal cron jobs and consume valuable PHP memory and database connections, WakeMetric performs 100% external synthetic health checks from our global edge network. Your WordPress site stays lightning-fast.
  • True External Reliability: When a server crashes, runs out of memory, or experiences a fatal PHP error, internal WordPress cron plugins fail silently and cannot send downtime alerts. WakeMetric monitors your site externally from the outside world, guaranteeing you are notified the moment your visitors cannot reach you.
  • 1-Click Instant Connect: You don’t need to sign up on a third-party website, create an API key, or enter credit card information. Click “Connect”, confirm your alert email, and monitoring activates instantly.
  • 100% Free Forever Community Plan: Enjoy continuous 15-minute uptime checks, SSL monitoring, domain expiry tracking, and instant email alerts at zero cost.
  • Privacy-First & European Hosted: Built with European privacy standards (GDPR compliant). We never inject tracking cookies, track your visitors, or collect sensitive post or customer data.

Key Features (Free Community Plan)

  • ⏱️ Continuous 24/7 Uptime Monitoring: Checks your homepage availability every 15 minutes from high-speed global monitoring nodes.
  • 🔔 Instant Downtime Email Alerts: Receive an alert email immediately when your website becomes unreachable or returns HTTP errors (500, 502, 503, 504, 403, 404).
  • 🔒 SSL / TLS Certificate Expiry Protection: Automatic advance warnings (at 30, 14, and 7 days before expiry) so your site never breaks with an embarrassing “Your connection is not private” browser security warning.
  • 🌐 Domain Expiration & RDAP Countdown: Authoritative WHOIS/RDAP registry tracking alerts you before your domain name expires, preventing domain hijacking or accidental loss of your online business.
  • 📊 WordPress Dashboard Widget: Quick-glance widget directly on your WordPress admin dashboard displaying your 30-day uptime percentage, live response latency, and SSL status.
  • ⚡ Response Time Latency Tracking: Monitor average HTTP response time in milliseconds to spot slow server performance before it hurts your Core Web Vitals.
  • 🌍 Multi-Region Global Cloud Network: Synthetic checks orchestrated across key internet hubs including Frankfurt, London, Virginia, Singapore, and Tokyo.
  • 🛡️ Enterprise-Grade Security: API keys stored with AES-256-GCM encryption in your database; all outbound communications authenticated with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce Stores & E-Commerce: Downtime directly kills sales and shopping cart conversions.
  • Agencies & Freelancers: Keep tabs on client websites without paying expensive monthly SaaS monitoring subscriptions.
  • Blogs & Business Sites: Protect your Google SEO search rankings from downtime penalties.
  • Membership & SaaS Platforms: Ensure login portals and member dashboards stay operational around the clock.

How It Works in 3 Simple Steps

  1. Install and activate the WakeMetric plugin.
  2. Confirm your alert notification email (detected automatically from your admin settings).
  3. Click Connect WakeMetric — It’s Free.

WakeMetric immediately initiates your first external health check and begins continuous 24/7 monitoring.

Privacy Policy

WakeMetric values user privacy and complies with European GDPR regulations.

WakeMetric collects and transmits the following data to WakeMetric servers (https://wakemetrics.com) solely to provide uptime, SSL, and domain monitoring services:

  • Your site URL (used to perform external HTTP/HTTPS health checks)
  • Your site name (used in email alert notifications)
  • Your designated alert email address (used solely to send downtime and expiration alerts)
  • WordPress version, plugin version, and PHP version (used for compatibility diagnosis)
  • Server locale

No personally identifiable user information, visitor data, customer details, passwords, or database contents are ever collected, processed, or stored.

You can review our complete Privacy Policy at: https://wakemetrics.com/privacy

To permanently stop all data transmission, simply click “Disconnect Site” on the WakeMetric settings page, or delete the plugin. All locally stored plugin data is completely removed upon uninstall.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Fastest)

  1. Log into your WordPress Admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for WakeMetric or WakeMetric Uptime Monitor.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  5. Go to WakeMetric in your admin menu and click Connect WakeMetric — It’s Free.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP archive from the WordPress.org Plugin Directory.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and follow the 1-click onboarding flow.
sections.faq:
Why should I use WakeMetric instead of a self-hosted monitoring plugin?

Self-hosted plugins run on your own WordPress hosting server. If your host goes down, experiences a kernel panic, or runs out of RAM, your WordPress site cannot execute PHP code — meaning the self-hosted plugin cannot send you a downtime alert! WakeMetric checks your website externally from high-speed cloud edge servers, ensuring guaranteed alerts even if your server completely shuts down.

Does WakeMetric slow down my WordPress site?

No, absolutely not. WakeMetric has zero impact on your site’s performance. All uptime verification, SSL inspection, and domain WHOIS checks run externally on WakeMetric’s high-speed cloud infrastructure. The plugin only makes lightweight authenticated API calls to fetch status data when you view your admin dashboard or via a non-blocking background transient.

Is the Community Plan really free forever?

Yes! The Community Plan is 100% free with no expiration date, no trial periods, and no credit card required. It includes 15-minute check intervals, SSL expiry alerts, domain expiry tracking, and downtime email notifications for your WordPress website.

What data is sent to WakeMetric during the one-click connect?

To establish monitoring and send downtime alerts, the plugin securely transmits your site URL, site name, alert email address, WordPress version, plugin version, and PHP version. WakeMetric never accesses, stores, or transmits your WordPress passwords, database credentials, post content, customer orders, or user personal data.

How do SSL certificate alerts work?

WakeMetric inspects your server’s SSL/TLS handshake from our cloud nodes. It reads the certificate’s issuer, cipher suite, and valid-to timestamp, and notifies you when your certificate has 30, 14, or 7 days remaining before expiration.

How do domain expiration alerts work?

WakeMetric queries authoritative ICANN RDAP and WHOIS registries to identify your domain registrar and renewal date. You receive advance alerts so you can renew your domain before it enters redemption or expires.

What happens if I disconnect or uninstall the plugin?

You can disconnect your site at any time with one click from the WakeMetric settings page. When you delete or uninstall the plugin, all locally stored options, API keys, transients, and scheduled cron hooks are permanently purged from your database.

Does the plugin support multisite?

The plugin currently supports single-site installations. Multisite network-wide activation is planned for an upcoming release.

What PHP and WordPress versions are supported?

WakeMetric requires WordPress 6.4 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher (fully tested up to PHP 8.4 and WordPress 7.1).
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Official WordPress.org release.
  • 1-Click instant connect with zero account registration required.
  • 24/7 automated uptime monitoring at 15-minute intervals.
  • SSL certificate health checks with 30, 14, and 7-day expiration alerts.
  • WHOIS & RDAP domain registration renewal tracking.
  • Native WordPress Admin Dashboard widget with live status badge.
  • Instant email alerts on verified downtime.
  • Full compatibility with PHP 7.4 through PHP 8.4 and WordPress 6.4 through 7.1.
